title: Khai báo phiếu yêu cầu ổ đĩa PersistentVolumeClaim 10Gi hạng gp3
code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: upload-pvc
spec:
  storageClassName: gp3
  accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
  resources: { requests: { storage: 10Gi } }

title: Tạo Headless Service cho cụm cơ sở dữ liệu StatefulSet
code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: postgres-headless
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  selector:
    app: postgres
